## F — Structured research index and consolidated VERIFY list: DUI law, implied consent, DUI penalties and ignition interlock devices
Knowledge facts: part C holds 38 fact blocks (sec20-F01 onward) from physical pages 65 to 67; part C2 holds 11 confusable blocks (sec20-R01 onward).
Exam authority: part A names the issuer, the September 2026 revision line and the written-test requirement; question count, passing standard, format and time limit are unknown.
VERIFY list:
- AZ-DUI-A-COUNT — written-test question count not printed in the manual (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- AZ-DUI-A-PASS — passing standard not printed; nothing shown to learners (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- AZ-DUI-A-FORMAT — item format not printed (owner EvidenceLibrarian).
- AZ-DUI-A-TIME — time limit not printed (owner EvidenceLibrarian).
- AZ-DUI-A-EDITION — issuer current-edition confirmation pending; issuer page was bot-challenged at intake (owner EvidenceLibrarian).
- AZ-DUI-D-EXTREMEJAIL — second extreme DUI jail minimum missing its number (owner EvidenceLibrarian).
- AZ-DUI-D-INTERLOCKLIST — interlock restricted license eligibility list unclear (owner EvidenceLibrarian).
- AZ-DUI-E-MARKET — market pack unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
- AZ-DUI-ETWO-TEARDOWN — competitive teardown unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
Dynamic facts: DUI fines, jail minimums, revocation periods and interlock eligibility are statutory and can be amended (for example sec20-F17, sec20-F22, sec20-F30, sec20-F35).
Index: exam authority in A; audience in B; knowledge facts with misconceptions, mnemonics, glossary and dynamic-fact lines in C; confusables in C2; accuracy in D; market in E and E2; definition-of-done matrix in G.

corpus_stability.reason: The Arizona Driver License Manual carries one revision line on its contents page (Revised September 2026) and points to Arizona Revised Statutes Title 28 for current law; nothing in the selected pages signals more than one rewrite per year.
